item.title: Arnold Classic 2026: Full list of winners
item.description: The Arnold Sports Festival hosted athletes and fans from all over the world in Columbus, Ohio this weekend. The event honors the legacy of Arnold Schwarzenegger. item.title: Uber and Lyft fees to LAX could rise significantly: Here's why
item.description: Getting to Los Angeles International Airport could soon cost significantly more for rideshare users. The LA Board of Airport Commissioners will meet to discuss a proposal that would raise rideshare fees for commercial vehicles entering LAX.Under the plan, a $6 base access fee would be charged for commercial vehicles entering the airport.
